description.value: Hiro Japan Sushi Xpress is a quick-serve Japanese food chain with a Victoria outlet inside Hillside Shopping Centre, offering fresh-made sushi, teriyaki meals, bento boxes, and Japanese noodle dishes. The concept was established in Vancouver in 2003 and prioritizes fresh, daily-made product with a focus on health and sustainability. A touring cyclist stopping at Hillside can grab a ready-made sushi or bento box to go.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 54m; rack at 57m; rack at 66m; rack at 76m; floor (covered) at 77m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Victoria location at Hillside Shopping Centre (#46A 1644 Hillside Avenue, Tel: 778-265-6940), consistent with the OSM coordinates near Hillside Ave. The site explicitly states food service 'for both on and off the premises,' confirming takeout. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Hiro Sushi Xpress' but the website consistently uses 'Hiro Japan Sushi Xpress' or 'Hiro Japan Xpress' — the OSM name omits 'Japan'.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website for the Victoria/Hillside location.
The website URL was 'discovered' rather than directly in OSM tags — confirmed it resolves to the correct business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active quick-serve sushi restaurant at Hillside Shopping Centre in Victoria with confirmed website and contact details. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a fast, affordable meal.
